page.overview:
What is The Edge?

The Edge is a massive plane surrounding the edge of the Multiverse which consists of billions of solar systems. It was introduced in the Edge of Eternities set.

The Edge, known as the Edge of Eternity or simply as Space to most of its inhabitants, is a massive universe that exists between the greater Multiverse and the infinite expanse beyond it.

The Edge is filled with billions of stars composed of mana, aether, hydrogen, helium, and other trace gasses. Planets form around these stars, with a handful of them capable of sustaining life.

The distance between two star systems is extremely vast, and while sub-lightspeed travel between them is possible, it is highly impractical. Most interstellar travel is done using Eternity Columns constructed by the Pinnacle. Eternity Columns allow ships to travel beyond lightspeed by slipping them in and out of a parallel plane known as the Weft.
